purpose: Teach: 病状/横綱/法王/君臨/演目/直訳/装い/床下

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの、本気で、絶対、病状、絶対、ご家族に、絶対、ご説明、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I've thoroughly explained the patient's condition to the family. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Steady professional tone without distance. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相撲の、本気で、絶対、横綱、絶対、健康診断、絶対、医療チームで、絶対、お引き受け、絶対、するそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the yokozuna's medical checkup — the entire medical team will be handling that, I hear?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity in the lift. Warm but not performative. Seeking confirmation like he respects the answer. Slight lean forward in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。海外の、本気で、絶対、法王、絶対、来日時の、絶対、医療体制、絶対、準備、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When the Holy Father visits from overseas, we're preparing the full medical infrastructure for his stay.
lines.style: Factual, clear briefing tone. Professional pride underneath — not boasting, just confident. Slight emphasis on 'preparing' showing thoroughness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療界に、本気で、絶対、君臨、絶対、される、絶対、教授、絶対、先生の、絶対、ご恩師ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That must be your mentor, the professor who really does reign over the medical world here.
lines.style: Respectful recognition in the voice. Not flattery — genuine acknowledgment. Thoughtful pacing. Slight wondering tone at the end.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。今月の、本気で、絶対、医学会の、絶対、演目、絶対、新治療法、絶対、ですよ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. This month's medical conference features a presentation on a new treatment protocol I'm developing.
lines.style: Professional matter-of-fact. Quiet pride without self-promotion. Even pacing. The detail of 'new protocol' gets steady, clear articulation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外の論文、本気で、絶対、直訳、絶対、ですと、絶対、ニュアンス、絶対、伝わりにくい、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Translating foreign research papers directly can lose the nuance, can't it? The meaning gets harder to convey.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant opening — genuine concern for accuracy. Soft pacing. The question at the end is collaborative, not rhetorical.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療現場の、本気で、絶対、装い、絶対、清潔感、絶対、大切ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. In medical practice, cleanliness and professional presentation are essential — they really do matter.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight emphasis on 'essential.' Patient, teaching-adjacent tone — informing without lecturing. Grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昔の家屋、本気で、絶対、床下、絶対、感染症、絶対、原因、絶対、になっていた、絶対、こと、絶対、聞いたことありますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard that in older homes, poor ventilation under the floorboards used to be a source of infection.
lines.style: Reflective, connecting past to present. Measured pacing with a note of gentle discovery. Trailing slightly at the end — the realization settling in.
